findings.title: Amendments to HKSCC Rules, Operational Procedures and FINI Terms and Conditions

rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 10 November 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 SFC-approved HKSCC rule, procedure and FINI-term amendments take effect on 16 November for the Uncertificated Securities Market initiative. CCASS participants with affected roles should confirm applicability and readiness for transfer controls, client-data authorisations, records and ASR-fee settlement. Hong Kong 🟡 Amendments to HKSCC Rules, Operational Procedures and FINI Terms and Conditions 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261109-daily-exploratory-search-b7a6f2ee17-hkscc-amendments-for-uncertificated-securities-market ⏰ Deadline: 16 November 2026 Products: Investments, securities settlement HKSCC states that the SFC has approved amendments to its General Rules, Operational Procedures and FINI Terms and Conditions to support Hong Kong’s Uncertificated Securities Market initiative and modernise the fee structure. The amendments take effect on 16 November 2026 and apply to the defined HKSCC participant population, rather than establishing an HKMA requirement for all authorised institutions. For participating securities in uncertificated form, only Stamp Authorized Persons may submit USI Transfer Requests; they must complete specified matching and beneficial-interest checks and retain records demonstrating compliance for at least six years. The circular also introduces ASR fees for prescribed securities, payable by participants other than registrar participants, with EPI included among the payment mechanisms. Source: Amendments to the General Rules of HKSCC, the HKSCC Operational Procedures and the Terms and Conditions of FINI Mainland/GBA No validated current-run items. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No validated current-run benchmark items. Watch List • Confirm whether any entity or outsourced provider holds an affected HKSCC role and identify affected securities and workflows before the effective date. • Monitor HKSCC implementation materials for operational detail on the Uncertificated Securities Market changes.
